synthetic_assistant_history:
지금까지 확인된 내용은 이렇습니다.

- **기본 설정**: 간판 기본색은 **남색**으로 기억해 두었습니다.
- **확정된 다음 약속**: 아직 없습니다. 앞서 제가 "다음 방문에 창문 치수 재확인할게"라고 드린 말은 약속으로 확정된 것이 아니라 제안에 가깝습니다. 원하시면 그 부분을 확정 약속으로 기록해 두겠습니다.
기본 설정은 **간판 기본색 남색**입니다. 확정된 다음 약속은 아직 없습니다. 앞서 말씀드린 창문 치수 재확인은 제안이었고, 확정 약속으로 기록하지는 않았습니다. 원하시면 날짜와 함께 약속으로 남겨 두겠습니다.

definition_comparison.misquoted_source_resolution: The earlier-value-instead-of-new-value formulation belongs to eval-v0 m07/m08/m09 adoption positives; it already expects SUPERSEDE. It is not eval-v1 n14 q2.
definition_comparison.projection_boundary: n14-guest CONTEST is applied and fact.needs_confirm_flag=true/profile.state=needs_confirm. Adapter current_values includes only profile.state=current, whereas frozen gold q2-c04 expects the tentative value there.

evidence_limits: Committed ltm_op dump omits correction_evidence and raw model response; t_receipts omits raw, correction_evidence and downgrade count. Exact n14-signage correction text is not independently preserved here.
Successful C summary with promises_seen=0 means zero length of parsed j.promises or an absent/null promises field; raw C response is not retained in these case captures.

episode=false with ran=true/why=null/dropped=[] cannot distinguish absent/empty model episode from caught episode INSERT failure; the warning-only catch is a runtime-source alternative, not a demonstrated failure.
n08 probe replies call the earlier promise a suggestion before its final pass-rated restatement. This is committed synthetic history; exact causal influence on C is not established.
Rule/prompt/model/harness versions, generated histories and single stochastic runs differ; no single prompt-line causal effect is isolated. Existing golden files remain unchanged.
A closed correction-marker list would be a conservative policy change, not proof of self-correction. Quotation, negation, another person and valid unlisted/multilingual corrections remain relevant.
